text:
sam: Heads-up: MIG-421 goes into the quiet window at 11:30 PST. I'll claim the window and run preflight checks now.
leah: noted. I'm going to pin api-service to v2.3.1 for the duration — avoids the new column access for the canary. `kubectl set image deploy/api api=api:v2.3.1`
mike: +1 on pin. Backfill estimate?
marisol: Backfill will touch ~120k rows, we expect ~1.5–2h at normal rate. I recommend rps cap of 200 to keep p99 under control.
sam: setting deploybot holdpoint now. @deploybot please start canary at 11:35 with 5% traffic for 10m, then 25% for 15m if green.
deploybot: deploybot: holdpoint claimed by sam. Canary schedule queued: step1=5%/10m, step2=25%/15m. Will emit signals to this thread.
nia: rollback criteria proposal: if >5% of canary requests error for 10m OR p50 latency regresses by >150ms sustained for 5m OR replication lag > 10s, rollback. Any objections?
leah: Sounds good. Add a soft cap: if background replication lag spikes >5s during backfill for 3 consecutive checks, scale down backfill by 2x.
mike: agree. Operational note: add DB lock watch — if any DDL lock holds >30s during apply, abort and escalate.
marisol: ack on lock watch. I'll add a short `pg_top` snapshot script to the cronjob preflight and push to the runbook.
sam: runbook snippet I'm using: ```
# preflight checks
- pin services to v2.3.1
- confirm replica lag < 200ms
- set backfill throttle: 200 rps
- start canary: 5%/10m -> 25%/15m
- rollback triggers: errors/latency/lag/locks
```
leah: deploybot: when canary reaches step2, please trigger the `schema-validate` job that verifies required indexes exist. If it fails, stop rollout.
deploybot: deploybot: canary step1 started at 3182027700. Monitoring p50/p95/p99 and errors in pipeline. Will post status updates.
mike: monitoring note: watch `write_latency_ms` and `txn_conflicts` dashboards, set alert at p95>400ms.
marisol: backfill started (dry-run mode) on a sampled shard to validate performance. No locks so far.
sam: if we see any long-running locks, we follow the two-step: try cancel backfill job, then pause migration and notify infra oncall.
nia: adding final acceptance: post-deploy smoke tests must pass for 20m on canary before wide rollout. If smoke fails, immediate rollback.
sam: all clear. I'll keep this thread as the control channel during the window. Ping here for any manual aborts. :thumbsup:
